name: DocuSeal
description: Let your AI work with DocuSeal, the open-source e-signature platform (Cloud US or EU, or self-hosted): find templates, submissions and signers, check who has signed, get signed documents and completion events, send templates or one-off PDFs for signature, update signers, and create, clone or archive templates from PDF, DOCX or HTML.
instructions:
## DocuSeal
This connector works with **DocuSeal**, the open-source document signing platform, through its REST API: on DocuSeal Cloud (`https://api.docuseal.com`, EU `https://api.docuseal.eu`) or on your own server (`https://<your host>/api`). It lists and reads templates, submissions (signature requests) and submitters (signers), gets signed documents and completion events, sends templates or one-off PDFs for signature, updates signers and submissions, and creates, clones, updates and archives templates.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Copy your API key: on DocuSeal Cloud at https://console.docuseal.com/api (EU accounts: https://console.docuseal.eu/api); on a self-hosted DocuSeal under **Settings → API** (`https://<your host>/settings/api`).
2. Paste it into `DOCUSEAL_API_KEY`. It is sent in the `X-Auth-Token` header and acts as the user it belongs to.
3. Set `DOCUSEAL_API_URL`: `https://api.docuseal.com` (Cloud, US), `https://api.docuseal.eu` (Cloud, EU) or `https://<your host>/api` for a self-hosted instance (the same address you open DocuSeal at, plus `/api`). No trailing slash.
4. Run `docuseal_list_templates` to check.

**Test mode**: DocuSeal Cloud has a test mode with its own API key (switch it in the console); test submissions are not legally binding and are free. Use the test key while you try the connector.

**Workflow**
- Templates: `docuseal_list_templates` (search by name with `q`, by `folder` or `external_id`), `docuseal_get_template` for roles and field names.
- Send for signature: `docuseal_create_submission` with the template id and one submitter per role (`role` must match the template's role names, e.g. "First Party"); pre-fill fields with `values` keyed by field name. `docuseal_create_submissions_from_emails` is the quick way for single-signer templates. `docuseal_create_submission_from_pdf` sends a one-off PDF without a template.
- Track: `docuseal_list_submissions` (filter by `status`, `template_id`, signer `q`), `docuseal_get_submission` (each submitter's status and timestamps, event history), `docuseal_list_submitters`, `docuseal_get_submitter`.
- Signed documents: `docuseal_get_submission_documents` (PDF links, `merge` for one file); `combined_document_url` and `audit_log_url` in the submission.
- What was signed lately: `docuseal_list_form_completed_events` (each signer who finished) and `docuseal_list_submission_completed_events` (fully signed submissions).
- Follow up: `docuseal_update_submitter` (fix an email, re-send the invitation with `send_email`, pre-fill values), `docuseal_update_submission` (rename, change expiry, archive or restore), `docuseal_archive_submission`.
- Build templates: `docuseal_create_template_from_pdf`, `docuseal_create_template_from_docx`, `docuseal_create_template_from_html`, `docuseal_clone_template`, `docuseal_update_template`, `docuseal_archive_template`.

**Sending is real: confirm first.** Creating a submission emails the signers (unless `send_email` is false), `completed: true` signs on someone's behalf, and archiving stops signing links. Show the user the template or document, the signers with their roles and the message, and send only after a clear yes.

**Files**: `documents[].file` takes a public URL (DocuSeal downloads it) or Base64 content. Fields come from text tags in the document, e.g. `{{Full Name;role=Signer;type=text}}`, `{{Sign here;role=Signer;type=signature}}`, `{{Date;role=Signer;type=date}}` (types: heading, text, signature, initials, date, number, image, checkbox, multiple, file, radio, select, cells, stamp, payment, phone, verification, kba, strikethrough), or from `fields` with exact `areas` (page, x, y, w, h as fractions of the page). HTML templates use tags such as `<text-field name="Name" role="Signer"></text-field>`.

**Reading the answers**: ids are integers. Times are ISO 8601 with time zone (`2026-10-30T14:05:00.000Z`). Submission `status`: pending, completed, declined, expired. Submitter `status`: awaiting (not yet invited, signing order), sent, opened, completed, declined. `embed_src` is the signer's personal signing link. Document URLs are temporary.

**Paging**: lists return `{"data": [...], "pagination": {"count", "next", "prev"}}`, newest first, 10 items by default (`limit` up to 100). Pass `pagination.next` as `after` for the next, older page; stop when `next` is null. The completed-event tools page the same way by completion time (Unix seconds).

**Errors**: 401 "Not authenticated" for a wrong or missing API key (or a Cloud key on the EU host and vice versa); 403 when the key's user may not see the item; 404 unknown id; 422 with an `error` message for invalid input (unknown role name, missing email, archived template, template without fields, unreadable file); 429 "Too many requests" when the rate limit is reached. Self-hosted instances answer 404 for every call when `/api` is missing from `DOCUSEAL_API_URL`.
prerequisites: A DocuSeal account (Cloud or self-hosted) and its API key, from console.docuseal.com/api or Settings, API on your own server.

DOCUSEAL_API_URL.label: API address
DOCUSEAL_API_URL.help: https://api.docuseal.com for DocuSeal Cloud, https://api.docuseal.eu for the EU cloud, or https://<your host>/api for a self-hosted DocuSeal.
DOCUSEAL_API_URL.patternMessage: Use https://api.docuseal.com, https://api.docuseal.eu or your server address followed by /api, without a trailing slash.

DOCUSEAL_API_KEY.label: API key
DOCUSEAL_API_KEY.help: DocuSeal Cloud: console.docuseal.com/api (or console.docuseal.eu/api). Self-hosted: Settings, API. Sent as the X-Auth-Token header.
DOCUSEAL_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: DocuSeal refused the API key. Copy it again from the API page, and check that DOCUSEAL_API_URL matches where the account lives (api.docuseal.com, api.docuseal.eu or your server plus /api).
verifyHints.404: Nothing answered at this address. For a self-hosted DocuSeal, DOCUSEAL_API_URL must end in /api, e.g. https://sign.example.com/api.

tools.name: docuseal_list_templates
tools.description: List document templates, newest first: id, name, slug, folder_name, external_id, the roles of its submitters, its fields (name, type, role, required) and documents. Filter by name (q), folder or external id.

q.description: Only templates whose name contains this text.

slug.description: Only the template with this slug.

external_id.description: Only templates with this external id (set when created through the API or the embedded builder).

folder.description: Only templates in this folder (folder name).

archived.description: true lists archived templates instead of active ones.

limit.description: Number of templates to return, 1 to 100 (default 10).

after.description: Paging: pass pagination.next of the previous answer to get the next (older) page. Lists are newest first.

before.description: Only templates with an id greater than this one (newer).

tools.name: docuseal_get_template
tools.description: Read one template: name, folder, roles (submitters with their uuid and name), fields (name, type, role, required, position), documents with download URLs, author and dates. Field names are the keys for pre-filled values.

tools.name: docuseal_list_submissions
tools.description: List signature requests (submissions), newest first: id, name, status (pending, completed, declined, expired), template, source, created and completed time, audit_log_url, combined_document_url and each submitter with email, role and status. Filter by template, status, folder or signer (q).

q.description: Only submissions with a submitter whose name, email or phone contains this text.

slug.description: Only the submission with this slug.

template_folder.description: Only submissions of templates in this folder.

archived.description: true returns only archived submissions, false only active ones.

limit.description: Number of submissions to return, 1 to 100 (default 10).

after.description: Paging: pass pagination.next of the previous answer to get the next (older) page. Lists are newest first.

before.description: Only submissions with an id greater than this one (newer).

tools.name: docuseal_get_submission
tools.description: Read one submission: status, each submitter (id, email, name, role, status: awaiting, sent, opened, completed, declined; sent_at, opened_at, completed_at, declined_at, the values they entered, embed_src signing link), the event history (submission_events), the signed documents and the audit log URL.

submission_id.description: Submission id, from docuseal_list_submissions or the submission_id of a submitter.

tools.name: docuseal_get_submission_documents
tools.description: Download links of a submission's documents: the signed PDFs once completed, the partly filled ones before. merge=true returns one combined PDF. The links expire after a while; download them soon.

submission_id.description: Submission id, from docuseal_list_submissions or the submission_id of a submitter.

merge.description: true merges all documents into one PDF.

tools.name: docuseal_list_submitters
tools.description: List submitters (signers) across submissions, newest first: id, submission_id, email, name, phone, role, status, sent, opened and completed times, values and metadata. Filter by submission, signer text (q), external id or completion date.

q.description: Only submitters whose name, email or phone contains this text.

slug.description: Only the submitter with this slug.

external_id.description: Only submitters with this external id.

completed_after.description: Only submitters who completed after this date and time, e.g. 2026-10-01 00:00:00 UTC.

completed_before.description: Only submitters who completed before this date and time.

limit.description: Number of submitters to return, 1 to 100 (default 10).

after.description: Paging: pass pagination.next of the previous answer to get the next (older) page. Lists are newest first.

before.description: Only submitters with an id greater than this one (newer).

tools.name: docuseal_get_submitter
tools.description: Read one submitter: email, name, role, status, sent, opened, completed or declined time and decline reason, the field values they entered, their documents and the embed_src signing link.

submitter_id.description: Submitter id, from docuseal_get_submission (submitters[].id) or docuseal_list_submitters.

tools.name: docuseal_list_form_completed_events
tools.description: Completed-form events, newest first: one per signer who finished (event_type form.completed, timestamp, and the submitter with values, documents and audit log), the same data a form.completed webhook carries. Use it to catch up on signatures since a time. Paged by completion time: pass pagination.next as after.

after.description: Only events completed before this Unix time in seconds (pass pagination.next for the next, older page).

before.description: Only events completed after this Unix time in seconds.

tools.name: docuseal_list_submission_completed_events
tools.description: Completed-submission events, newest first: one per submission whose signers all finished (event_type submission.completed, timestamp, and the submission with submitters, documents and audit log). Paged by completion time: pass pagination.next as after.

after.description: Only events completed before this Unix time in seconds (pass pagination.next for the next, older page).

before.description: Only events completed after this Unix time in seconds.

tools.name: docuseal_create_submission
tools.description: Send a template for signature: creates a submission with one submitter per template role and, unless send_email is false, emails each signer their link (in order, or all at once with order random). Pre-fill fields with values. Returns the submitters with id, status and embed_src signing link. Confirm signers and template with the user first.

submitters.description: Signers, one per template role, e.g. [{"role": "First Party", "email": "anna@example.com", "name": "Anna", "values": {"Company": "ACME"}}]. Each may set email, phone, name, role, values (pre-filled fields by field name), external_id, metadata, send_email, send_sms, completed (true signs automatically), order, require_email_2fa, message, fields (per-field settings: readonly, required, default_value).

send_email.description: false creates the request without emailing the signers (share the embed_src links yourself). Default true.

send_sms.description: true also invites signers by SMS (phone required; paid feature).

order.description: preserved (default) signs in role order, one after the other; random lets everyone sign at the same time.

completed_redirect_url.description: URL the signer is sent to after signing.

bcc_completed.description: Email address that gets a BCC of the signed documents.

reply_to.description: Reply-To address for the invitation emails.

expire_at.description: Expiry date and time after which nobody can sign, e.g. 2026-12-31 23:59:59 UTC.

message.description: Custom invitation email: {"subject": "...", "body": "..."}. The body may use {{submitter.link}}, {{template.name}}, {{account.name}} and other DocuSeal variables.

variables.description: Values for dynamic content variables of the template, e.g. {"customer_name": "ACME"}.

tools.name: docuseal_create_submissions_from_emails
tools.description: Quick send: one submission per email address for a single-signer template, invitations sent right away. Use docuseal_create_submission for several roles or pre-filled values.

emails.description: Comma-separated email addresses, e.g. anna@example.com, ben@example.com.

send_email.description: false creates the submissions without sending emails. Default true.

message.description: Custom invitation email: {"subject": "...", "body": "..."}. The body may use {{submitter.link}}, {{template.name}}, {{account.name}} and other DocuSeal variables.

tools.name: docuseal_create_submission_from_pdf
tools.description: Send a one-off PDF for signature without saving a template first: give the PDF (URL or Base64) with text tags or field positions, and the signers. Emails go out unless send_email is false. Confirm with the user first.

documents.description: Documents, each {"name": "...", "file": "<PDF URL or Base64 content>"}; optional "fields" with exact positions. Fields can also be text tags inside the document, e.g. {{Name;role=Signer;type=text}} and {{Sign;role=Signer;type=signature}}.

items.description: One document: name, file, optional fields.

submitters.description: Signers, one per template role, e.g. [{"role": "First Party", "email": "anna@example.com", "name": "Anna", "values": {"Company": "ACME"}}]. Each may set email, phone, name, role, values (pre-filled fields by field name), external_id, metadata, send_email, send_sms, completed (true signs automatically), order, require_email_2fa, message, fields (per-field settings: readonly, required, default_value).

send_email.description: false creates the request without emailing the signers (share the embed_src links yourself). Default true.

send_sms.description: true also invites signers by SMS (phone required; paid feature).

order.description: preserved (default) signs in role order, one after the other; random lets everyone sign at the same time.

completed_redirect_url.description: URL the signer is sent to after signing.

bcc_completed.description: Email address that gets a BCC of the signed documents.

reply_to.description: Reply-To address for the invitation emails.

expire_at.description: Expiry date and time after which nobody can sign, e.g. 2026-12-31 23:59:59 UTC.

message.description: Custom invitation email: {"subject": "...", "body": "..."}. The body may use {{submitter.link}}, {{template.name}}, {{account.name}} and other DocuSeal variables.

flatten.description: true removes PDF form fields from the documents.

merge_documents.description: true merges several documents into one PDF.

remove_tags.description: true removes the {{text tags}} from the document (default true).

tools.name: docuseal_update_submission
tools.description: Rename a submission, change its expiry date, or archive and unarchive it.

submission_id.description: Submission id, from docuseal_list_submissions or the submission_id of a submitter.

expire_at.description: New expiry date and time, e.g. 2026-12-31 23:59:59 UTC.

archived.description: true archives, false restores the submission.

tools.name: docuseal_archive_submission
tools.description: Archive a submission: its signing links stop working. It can be restored with docuseal_update_submission (archived false). Confirm with the user first.

submission_id.description: Submission id, from docuseal_list_submissions or the submission_id of a submitter.

tools.name: docuseal_update_submitter
tools.description: Change a submitter of a pending submission: correct name, email or phone, pre-fill or change field values, set metadata, re-send the invitation (send_email true), or sign on their behalf (completed true). Confirm with the user first.

submitter_id.description: Submitter id, from docuseal_get_submission (submitters[].id) or docuseal_list_submitters.

phone.description: New phone number in international format, e.g. +491701234567.

values.description: Field values by field name, e.g. {"Company": "ACME"}.

external_id.description: Your own id for this submitter.

metadata.description: Your own data stored with the submitter.

send_email.description: true sends the invitation email again.

send_sms.description: true sends the invitation SMS again.

completed.description: true marks the submitter as completed and signs automatically.

completed_redirect_url.description: URL the signer is sent to after signing.

require_email_2fa.description: true asks the signer for a one-time code sent by email.

message.description: Custom invitation email: {"subject": "...", "body": "..."}. The body may use {{submitter.link}}, {{template.name}}, {{account.name}} and other DocuSeal variables.

items.description: One field: name, default_value, readonly, required, validation, preferences.

tools.name: docuseal_create_template_from_pdf
tools.description: Create a reusable template from one or more PDFs (URL or Base64). Fields come from text tags in the PDF ({{Field;role=Signer;type=signature}}) or from exact field positions. Returns the template with its id, roles and fields.

documents.description: Documents, each {"name": "...", "file": "<PDF URL or Base64 content>"}; optional "fields" with exact positions. Fields can also be text tags inside the document, e.g. {{Name;role=Signer;type=text}} and {{Sign;role=Signer;type=signature}}.

items.description: One document: name, file, optional fields.

folder_name.description: Folder to put the template in.

external_id.description: Your own id for the template. An existing template with the same external id gets the new PDF instead of a new template being created.

shared_link.description: true (the default) lets anyone with the template link start a submission; false keeps it private.

flatten.description: true removes PDF form fields from the documents.

remove_tags.description: true removes the {{text tags}} from the document (default true).

tools.name: docuseal_create_template_from_docx
tools.description: Create a reusable template from a Word DOCX file (URL or Base64), with fields from text tags such as {{Field;role=Signer;type=date}} or from positions. Dynamic documents can use [[variables]].

documents.description: Documents, each {"name": "...", "file": "<DOCX URL or Base64 content>"}; optional "fields" with exact positions. Fields can also be text tags inside the document, e.g. {{Name;role=Signer;type=text}} and {{Sign;role=Signer;type=signature}}.

items.description: One document: name, file, optional fields.

folder_name.description: Folder to put the template in.

external_id.description: Your own id for the template.

shared_link.description: true (the default) lets anyone with the template link start a submission; false keeps it private.

tools.name: docuseal_create_template_from_html
tools.description: Create a template from HTML: DocuSeal renders it to PDF and turns <text-field>, <signature-field>, <date-field>, <checkbox-field> and similar tags into fillable fields, e.g. <signature-field name="Signature" role="Signer"></signature-field>.

html.description: The HTML of the document, with field tags.

html_header.description: HTML repeated as header on every page.

html_footer.description: HTML repeated as footer on every page.

folder_name.description: Folder to put the template in.

external_id.description: Your own id for the template.

shared_link.description: true (the default) lets anyone with the template link start a submission; false keeps it private.

tools.name: docuseal_clone_template
tools.description: Copy a template into a new one, optionally with a new name, folder and external id. Returns the new template.

external_id.description: Your own id for the copy.

tools.name: docuseal_update_template
tools.description: Rename a template, move it to another folder, rename its roles, or archive and unarchive it.

folder_name.description: Folder to move the template to (created if missing).

roles.description: New role names in the order of the template's submitters, e.g. ["Customer", "Company"].

archived.description: true archives, false restores the template.

tools.name: docuseal_archive_template
tools.description: Archive a template so it can no longer be sent. Existing submissions stay. It can be restored with docuseal_update_template (archived false). Confirm with the user first.
